_comment: C-first candidate for apply.c:doapply(BELL) -> use_bell(). Wish an explicitly uncursed ordinary bell, then apply it from the C-observed inventory letter. The C trace must confirm ordinary, audible, non-swallowed behavior and reach Hero_playnotes, the ring message, wakem=true, and wake_nearby; do not substitute Bell of Opening behavior. The first bounded attempt used `p` and C reported “You don’t have that object”; its trace showed the wished bell at inventory letter `n`. This corrected recipe changes only the selector to `n`.
